explanation: Private helper: shifting a block of m terms by 2(n+1) raises its sum by at least m(n+1). It is proved in Lean and is correct as a combinatorial lemma about sequences; it supports the paper's Lemma 1/2 counting argument. Source: Erdős–Fajtlowicz–Staton, 'Degree sequences in triangle-free graphs', Discrete Math. 92 (1991) 85–88. The full text was not accessible; the zbMATH review summary says that triangle-free graphs in which no degree occurs more than twice are bipartite, and that every triangle-free graph is an induced subgraph of one in which no degree occurs more than three times.
